theorem TraceSim.bag_count_with_other (b : Etcdraft.Bag) (m m' : Etcdraft.Msg) (h : m' ≠ m) :
    (b.with m').count m = b.count m

theorem TraceSim.bagCnt_sub (b : Etcdraft.Bag) (f : Etcdraft.Msg → Nat) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) (n : Nat)
    (h : TraceSim.BagCnt b f) : TraceSim.BagCnt (b.sub m n) fun x => if m = x then f x - n else f x

theorem TraceSim.bagCnt_plus (c : Etcdraft.Bag) (g : Etcdraft.Msg → Nat) (hcg : TraceSim.BagCnt c g)
    (b : Etcdraft.Bag) (f : Etcdraft.Msg → Nat) : TraceSim.BagCnt b f → TraceSim.BagCnt (b.plus c)
    fun x => f x + g x

theorem TraceSim.bagCnt_add (b : Etcdraft.Bag) (f : Etcdraft.Msg → Nat) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) (n : Nat)
    (hn : 0 < n) (h : TraceSim.BagCnt b f) : TraceSim.BagCnt (b.add m n) fun x => f x + if m = x
    then n else 0

theorem TraceSim.without_step (m : Etcdraft.Msg) (it : Etcdraft.Msg × Nat) : (if (it.fst == m) =
    true then if it.snd > 1 then some (it.fst, it.snd - 1) else none else some it) = none ∧ it.fst =
    m ∨ ∃ n, (if (it.fst == m) = true then if it.snd > 1 then some (it.fst, it.snd - 1) else none
    else some it) = some (it.fst, n) ∧ (it.fst ≠ m → n = it.snd)

theorem TraceSim.flatMap_update_perm {K V : Type} [DecidableEq K] (C : List K) (f g : K → List V) (i
    : K) (hnd : C.Nodup) (hi : i ∈ C) (P' : List V) (hg : g i = f i ++ P') (ho : ∀ (j : K), j ≠ i →
    g j = f j) : (List.flatMap g C).Perm (List.flatMap f C ++ P')

theorem TraceSim.bag_count_without_other (b : Etcdraft.Bag) (m m' : Etcdraft.Msg) (h : m' ≠ m) :
    (b.without m').count m = b.count m

theorem TraceSim.bagCnt_minus (c : Etcdraft.Bag) (g : Etcdraft.Msg → Nat) (hcg : TraceSim.BagCnt c
    g) (b : Etcdraft.Bag) (f : Etcdraft.Msg → Nat) : TraceSim.BagCnt b f → TraceSim.BagCnt (b.minus
    c) fun x => f x - g x

theorem TraceSim.bagRep_without (b : Etcdraft.Bag) (l : List Etcdraft.Msg) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) (h :
    TraceSim.BagRep b l) (hm : m ∈ l) : TraceSim.BagRep (b.without m) (l.erase m)

theorem TraceSim.sub_step (m : Etcdraft.Msg) (n : Nat) (it : Etcdraft.Msg × Nat) : (if (it.fst == m)
    = true then if it.snd > n then some (it.fst, it.snd - n) else none else some it) = none ∧ it.fst
    = m ∧ it.snd ≤ n ∨ ∃ k, (if (it.fst == m) = true then if it.snd > n then some (it.fst, it.snd -
    n) else none else some it) = some (it.fst, k) ∧ (it.fst = m → k = it.snd - n ∧ it.snd > n) ∧
    (it.fst ≠ m → k = it.snd)

def TraceSim.BagCnt (b : Etcdraft.Bag) (f : Etcdraft.Msg → Nat) : Prop :=
  b.domain.Nodup ∧ (∀ (it : Etcdraft.Msg × Nat), it ∈ b → 0 < it.snd) ∧ ∀ (m : Etcdraft.Msg), b.count m = f m

theorem TraceSim.bag_count_filter (b : Etcdraft.Bag) (p : Etcdraft.Msg → Bool) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) :
    (b.filterMsgs p).count m = if p m = true then b.count m else 0

theorem TraceSim.bagRep_iff (b : Etcdraft.Bag) (l : List Etcdraft.Msg) : TraceSim.BagRep b l ↔
    TraceSim.BagCnt b fun m => List.count m l

theorem TraceSim.bagRep_foldl_with (P' : List Etcdraft.Msg) (b : Etcdraft.Bag) (l : List
    Etcdraft.Msg) : TraceSim.BagRep b l → TraceSim.BagRep (List.foldl Etcdraft.Bag.with b P') (l ++
    P')

theorem TraceSim.bagCnt_filter (b : Etcdraft.Bag) (f : Etcdraft.Msg → Nat) (p : Etcdraft.Msg → Bool)
    (h : TraceSim.BagCnt b f) : TraceSim.BagCnt (b.filterMsgs p) fun m => if p m = true then f m
    else 0

theorem TraceSim.bag_count_add (b : Etcdraft.Bag) (m x : Etcdraft.Msg) (n : Nat) : (b.add m n).count
    x = b.count x + if m = x then n else 0

def TraceSim.BagRep (b : Etcdraft.Bag) (l : List Etcdraft.Msg) : Prop :=
  b.domain.Nodup ∧ (∀ (it : Etcdraft.Msg × Nat), it ∈ b → 0 < it.snd) ∧ ∀ (m : Etcdraft.Msg), b.count m = List.count m l

theorem TraceSim.bag_without_domain (b : Etcdraft.Bag) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) : (b.without
    m).domain.Sublist b.domain

theorem TraceSim.bagRep_with (b : Etcdraft.Bag) (l : List Etcdraft.Msg) (m : Etcdraft.Msg) (h :
    TraceSim.BagRep b l) : TraceSim.BagRep (b.with m) (l ++ [m])

theorem TraceSim.bag_count_sub (b : Etcdraft.Bag) (m x : Etcdraft.Msg) (n : Nat) (hnd :
    b.domain.Nodup) : (b.sub m n).count x = if m = x then b.count x - n else b.count x

theorem TraceSim.bagRep_perm (b : Etcdraft.Bag) (l l' : List Etcdraft.Msg) (h : TraceSim.BagRep b l)
    (hp : l.Perm l') : TraceSim.BagRep b l'
